Name: Rock Slug
Description:
Small, slimy, and hard to spot.
Don't wear any of your good shirts around it!

Name: Goblin Goon
Description:
A pittiful goon.
Does paltry damage when it isn't groveling.

Ability.Name: Pokin' Stick
Ability.Description:
Wait. This is just a rusty nail!
Has a chance to give you tetanus.

Name: Goblin Big-Boss
Description:
Bigger and tougher than his underlings, this goblin is particuarily cantankerous.
Don't let him poke you!

AbilityList.Name: Rock Pounder
AbilityList.Description: A mighty slam that can smash through solid rock.

Name: Test Boss
Description: What do you want me to say? It's a test.
